Guwahati Beheading Suspect Dies After Falling From Police Vehicle

The husband accused of beheading his wife in Guwahati has died after falling from a police vehicle while allegedly attempting to escape. The incident occurred in Assam. The accused was being transported by police when he reportedly jumped from the vehicle, leading to his fatal fall. Details regarding the exact circumstances of the fall and the police's actions are emerging.
